notes.title: Launch Event: Koi Zen: Opposite Color Soundtrack!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the release of the highly anticipated soundtrack of Koi Zen: Opposite Color! Now, you can immerse yourself in the unique atmosphere of this incredible game by listening to its captivating melodies on popular music platforms like Spotify, YouTube Music, and Amazon Music.

Crafted by the talented composer João Alves.N, the Koi Zen: Opposite Color soundtrack is an auditory journey that perfectly complements the game's exciting and challenging adventure. 

Don't wait any longer! Experience the magic of Koi Zen: Opposite Color's music today. Just search for the game's name or the composer's name, João Alves.N, on the following platforms:

Soundtrack Links:

[url=https://open.spotify.com/album/7limWUEjRPIFmV8ey5UFKN?si=wQyMQNZYTAKASX0rd2DPZw]Spotify[/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.0.2
notes.content:
* Balancing in phase 48. (The solution was not affected, we simply added some facilitators based on feedback).
* Game Engine Update.

notes.title: Specific Troubleshooting with the Control
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

We're thrilled to announce the launch of our latest and most exhilarating game! Thank you for being a part of this journey by acquiring our game and diving into challanging puzzles.

Your support and feedback have been invaluable to us. We investigated an issue affecting some Steam accounts, where an error related to Steam VR impacted game controls. But fear not, we've found a temporary fix! Simply click anywhere on the screen with your mouse  and your controller should work seamlessly.

If you encounter any other challenges or have further details to share, please let us know. Your input helps us improve the gaming experience for everyone.

Feedback: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2449680/discussions/0/7405656898325747208/
Bug Report: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2449680/discussions/0/7405656898325735641/

Thank you for being part of our gaming community. Join the adventure today and let the excitement begin!

Best regards,
Moon Mind Studio team
